entities.name: Q20296 (C. elegans HDAC6)
observations: The supplied 768-aa sequence matched reviewed UniProt Q20296 at 100% identity and 100% query coverage; reference target coverage was 80.4%.
Pfam identified two Hist_deacetyl domains at residues 34–330 and 446–746.

The reference annotates probable histone/protein lysine deacetylase activity (EC 3.5.1.98), zinc cofactor, and nucleus/cytoplasm localization; these are reference annotations, not direct activity/localization measurements of the submitted sequence.
Sequence-derived estimates: molecular mass 86.36 kDa, pI 5.36, GRAVY −0.3465.
